title: 小学六年级
description: 适合11-12岁孩子，章节书流利阅读、纪录片深度观看、辩论与观点表达
descriptionEn: For children aged 11-12. Fluent chapter book reading, deep documentary watching, debate and opinion expression.

items.description: 用搞笑短剧讲真实历史，莎士比亚到二战全覆盖，英式幽默+历史词汇量爆炸。
items.descriptionEn: Funny sketches about real history, from Shakespeare to WWII. British humor plus explosive history vocabulary.

items.description: 动画短片讲解思维谜题、科学现象、历史故事，每集一个知识点，适合碎片化学习。
items.descriptionEn: Animated shorts explaining brain puzzles, science phenomena, history stories. One topic per episode, perfect for bite-sized learning.

items.description: 四个小学生组成侦探社解决邻里谜案，推理对话+日常口语，澳洲口音。
items.descriptionEn: Four primary students form a detective agency solving neighborhood mysteries. Deduction dialogue plus daily colloquial. Australian accent.

items.description: 三个孩子在新学校建立自己的体育联盟，澳洲校园生活+运动词汇+友谊主题。
items.descriptionEn: Three kids start their own sports league at a new school. Australian school life plus sports vocabulary plus friendship themes.

items.description: 大卫·爱登堡解说自然纪录片，少儿版语速适中，环保议题+高级科普词汇。
items.descriptionEn: David Attenborough narrated nature documentary. Kids' version has moderate speed. Environmental topics plus advanced science vocabulary.

items.description: 美国女孩在英国海岛与马建立友谊的成长故事，青少年对话+情感表达。
items.descriptionEn: An American girl on a British island builds friendship with a horse. Teen dialogue plus emotional expression.

items.description: BBC最长寿的儿童节目，手工制作、挑战任务、动物嘉宾应有尽有，地道英式英语。
items.descriptionEn: BBC's longest-running children's show. Crafts, challenge tasks, animal guests. Authentic British English.

items.description: BBC儿童新闻节目，用孩子能懂的语言讲时事，新闻英语+全球视野。
items.descriptionEn: BBC children's news program. Current events explained in kid-friendly language. News English plus global perspective.

items.description: Steve Backshall寻找全球最致命的动物，野生动物纪录片风格，高阶科普英语。
items.descriptionEn: Steve Backshall hunts for the world's deadliest animals. Wildlife documentary style, advanced science English.
